plan.name: Collect exact pytest acceptance results offline
plan.summary: Complete step 6 of parent #564 in one plumbing change: enable a default host-selected pytest adapter for captured Python parts throughout public drafting, builder tools, queues and fresh final checks, using new regular discoverable acceptance files and one independent test_one invocation per exact part-relative function, class method or concrete parameter node ID; validate direct pytest and python3 -m pytest templates before preparation, preserve supported captured flags, match node IDs literally without a shell or -k, and refuse unsafe templates, file/class/group selections, duplicate or ambiguous collection and unsupported frameworks without fallback. Add a factory-owned pytest integration and a Python-only prepared Docker process transport, with helpers outside candidate storage, separate diagnostic and evidence channels, source rechecks and fresh invocation/full-identity/source/configuration bindings: require exactly one collected item, its real call and completed teardown/session/process for a candidate pass, admit completed assertion failures on base, refuse skips, xfail/xpass, deselection, absent calls, incomplete or conflicting evidence, forged output, replay and tampering, and classify unavailable pytest/plugins/import configuration, fixtures and environment failures as setup. Admit completed import or collection failure only when structured framework exceptions and conservative source analysis establish that the selected pinned test uses a missing proposed API of an otherwise working local production module, including a direct from-import used by that function or method; unrelated imports, missing distributions, broken conftest, malformed setup and ambiguous attribution never qualify, and each corrected candidate still needs a normal runtime pass. Reuse captured dependencies without fetching pytest during checks, the original whole-run and shared test-phase deadlines, cancellation vetoes even after failure, serial parts, private staging, bounded uncanceled process/container cleanup and queue ownership through cleanup; preserve explicit trusted adapter contracts, existing Go behavior and legacy hashes/locks, add default daemon-free selection/transport/refusal checks plus the real Python 3.13 and pytest 8.3.5 offline pinned-image acceptance matrix (enabled opt-in fails on absent prerequisites), and revise the named older tests that describe Python as unsupported or deny its new process capability while retaining their other assertions. Update SPEC.md, the README within 400 lines, docs/factory.md and planning/build prompts to describe supported pytest commands, exact evidence and conservative import attribution, the offline opt-in and remaining TypeScript/legacy restrictions with external plumbing still disabled; cite recorded grounds D-0107, D-0108, D-0121, D-0173, D-0281, D-0282, D-0301, D-0305 and applicable earlier native/Go refinements in SPEC, leave recording the new pytest refinement to the merger because plumbing cannot write decisions/, and retain affected real Python and TLAPS checks as CI requirements.

tests.name: TestPytestLiteralSelection617
tests.says: Default pytest selection preserves literal full node IDs and supported command policy, refuses unsafe commands and ownership errors before launch, and keeps trusted overrides.

tests.name: TestPytestNeedsEvidenceBeyondConsole617
tests.says: Supported pytest reaches the prepared environment, but console text and suite success cannot qualify a draft or candidate without individual framework evidence.

tests.name: TestPytestPreparedPythonCapability617
tests.says: Prepared offline Python environments expose process transport and acceptance capability without staging helpers for ordinary commands; TypeScript remains command-only.

tests.name: TestPytestOfflineExactResults617
tests.says: Real pinned pytest independently fails every exact selector on base and passes unchanged tests after production-only corrections across same-named files, two parts, methods and punctuated parameter cases; a passing neighbor blocks qualification.

tests.name: TestPytestOfflineRefusals617
tests.says: Real pytest refuses skips, xfail/xpass, absent calls, ambiguous or altered collection, incomplete sessions and forged diagnostics, and distinguishes setup failures from qualifying failures.

tests.name: TestPytestOfflineMissingAPI617
tests.says: A completed, selected missing local production API import can qualify base, unrelated or ambiguous import failures cannot, and implementing the API requires a fresh runtime pass.

tests.name: TestPytestOfflineAuthority617
tests.says: Captured policy and pinned source control real pytest runs; replayed, truncated and conflicting event streams or changed source/configuration cannot qualify.

tests.name: TestPytestOfflineLifetime617
tests.says: Pytest checks retain shared deadlines, void base evidence on cancellation or timeout, and keep queue ownership through bounded uncanceled cleanup.

tests.name: TestPytestOfflineBuilder617
tests.says: Standalone and shared-queue builder tools use captured pytest authority and fresh final checks; a post-tool regression blocks review and readiness.
